questions.text: What were you doing before you died?

questions.text_zh: 你是有罪的还是无罪的？

who_are_you: Jean-Pierre Morineau, wine merchant. Alas, but none of that matters anymore.
how_died: (He touches his chest) Heart attack. That night I went out for a walk, didn't expect to encounter a fire. I wanted to help, but my heart couldn't take it, and I just...
before_death: Oh, I was processing documents, then insomnia drove me out for a walk. You know, Madame, this city is full of noisy commoners... The city is very quiet at three in the morning.
guilty: Oh my God! I swear, I never in my life thought to harm anyone. Everything I did was just to give my family a better life. What's wrong with that?

who_are_you: 让-皮埃尔·莫里纳，红酒商人。唉，但那都不重要了。
how_died: （他摸了摸自己的胸口）心脏病。那天晚上我出门散步，没想到遇见火灾，我本想去帮忙的，结果心脏受不住，我就......
before_death: 哦，我本来在处理文件，然后失眠出门散步。你知道，女士，这座城市里充满了喧嚣的庸人....凌晨三点的城市很安静。
guilty: 哦天哪！我发誓，我这辈子可从没想过要伤害过任何人。我所作的一切只是想给家人更好的生活。这有什么错？

items.name: Insurance Policy
items.question: What is this insurance policy?
dialogue: Property insurance, perfectly normal risk management. Didn't expect something would actually happen. Pity I died—can't collect a single coin now.
dialogue_zh: 房屋保险，很正常的风险管理。没想到真出事了，可惜我死了，一个硬币都拿不到。

items.name: Clothing Traces
items.question: You have no burns on you.
dialogue: Because I never made it into the fire—my heart betrayed me first.
dialogue_zh: 因为我没来得及进火场，我的心脏就背叛了我。

items.name: Café Receipt
items.question: Why were you at the café across the street at 3 AM?
items.question_zh: 凌晨三点为什么在街对面咖啡馆？
dialogue: Insomnia. Wanted to find a quiet place to sit. Pure coincidence.
dialogue_zh: 失眠，想找个安静地方坐坐。纯粹是巧合。

items.name: Matchbox
items.question: Three matches are missing.
dialogue: For lighting cigars. Sometimes matches get damp and you need to strike a few extra. Any other questions?
dialogue_zh: 抽雪茄用的，有时候火柴受潮要多划几根。还有什么问题吗？

npc_comment.skull: Ha, this guy—wonder if his corpse will end up hanging from a lamppost. What do you think, Boss?
npc_comment.skull_zh: 哈，这家伙，也不知道他的尸体会不会被吊路灯。怎么说，老大？
npc_comment.lucifer: What was he thinking when he died? The answer is: 'I won.'
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: 他死的时候在想什么？答案是：'我赢了'。

who_are_you: Thomas Brennan, firefighter. Former firefighter. Work injury—the permanent kind.
how_died: We were already planning to just fight the fire, no rescue. But... I heard a child crying on the fourth floor, so I... went in.
before_death: I used this axe to break down the door, picked up the child, ran downstairs. Didn't expect the third floor to collapse. Too much smoke... couldn't catch a single breath.
guilty: I didn't save that child. I lied to my fiancée, told her I was visiting my parents. I hope God forgives my sins.

who_are_you: 托马斯·布伦南，消防员。前消防员。工伤，永久性的那种。
how_died: 本来我们已经打算只灭火不救援了，但...我听见四楼有孩子哭，我就...进去了。
before_death: 我用这把斧头劈开门，抱起那孩子，往楼下跑。没想到三楼楼板塌了，烟太大....一口气没呼吸上来。
guilty: 我没救出那个孩子，我还对未婚妻撒谎说去探望父母，我希望上帝原谅我的罪。

items.name: Engagement Ring
items.question: Whose ring is this?
dialogue: My engagement ring. Can't wear it on calls. There wasn't time to go back and put it in my locker... so I just stuffed it in my pocket.
dialogue_zh: 我的订婚戒指。出警不能戴，当时实在是来不及回去放储物柜...就直接塞口袋里。

items.name: Resignation Letter
items.question: What is this resignation letter?
dialogue: My fiancée said if I didn't quit, she'd call off the engagement. I was going to submit it next week.
dialogue_zh: 未婚妻说再不辞职就取消婚约。我本来打算下周交的。

items.name: Fire Axe
items.question: The fire axe.
dialogue: First day using this axe. When I was running with her in my arms, she said she was scared. I told her not to be afraid. I lied to her.
dialogue_zh: 这把斧头第一天用。我抱着她跑的时候，她说我害怕。我说别怕。我骗了她。

npc_comment.skull: Is he a good person or an idiot? ...Or are those two the same thing?
npc_comment.skull_zh: 他到底算好人还是傻子？……还是说这俩是一回事？
npc_comment.lucifer: An unquestionably good person, isn't he? If you need someone to sacrifice themselves again, he'd certainly be willing.
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: 毫无争议的好人，不是吗？如果你需要让谁再牺牲一次，他一定会愿意的。

who_are_you: Eileen Walsh... accountant... sorry, I'm too tired, can't remember.
how_died: Smelled smoke, thought someone would handle it. Then I was here.
before_death: I was sleeping. Too tired. Wanted to lie down just one more minute.
guilty: I didn't do anything. I was just too tired.

who_are_you: 艾琳·沃什……会计……对不起，我太累了，想不起来了。
how_died: 闻到烟味了，想着会有人处理的。然后我就在这里了。
before_death: 我在睡觉。太累了。想再躺一分钟。
guilty: 我没做什么啊。我只是太累了。

items.name: Why not run?
items.question: Why didn't you run when you smelled smoke?
items.question_zh: 你闻到烟味为什么不跑？
dialogue: I thought someone would handle it. Just wait a little longer.
dialogue_zh: 我想着会有人处理的。再等一下就好了。

items.name: Did you see flames?
items.question: Did you see the flames?
dialogue: Yes. Orange-red. Should go out soon, right?
dialogue_zh: 看见了。橘红色的。应该很快就会灭了吧。

items.name: Why not call police?
items.question: Why didn't you call the police?
dialogue: I thought someone already did. Someone always does, right?
dialogue_zh: 我以为有人报了。总会有人报的吧。

items.name: Regrets?
items.question: Do you regret it?
dialogue: I should have gotten up earlier. But I was too tired. Just wait a little longer...
dialogue_zh: 我应该早点起来的。但我太累了。再等一下……

npc_comment.skull: She didn't do anything bad. But she didn't do anything at all. What does that count as?
npc_comment.skull_zh: 她没做什么坏事。但她也什么都没做。这算什么？
npc_comment.lucifer: 'Just wait a little longer'—what gentle words. And then there was no 'then.'
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: '再等一下'——多么温柔的三个字。然后就没有然后了。

who_are_you: I'm Emily. Sorry, did I... did I do something wrong?
how_died: There was a fire, it was so hot, so hot. The nanny said to stay in the room, don't come out, the room must be safe... I was so scared.
before_death: An uncle picked me up. He said don't be afraid. But then there was so much smoke, and I couldn't remember anything after that.
guilty: Mommy said I'm a bad child... she said she'll never forgive my existence... but I didn't know... I should have been better behaved...

who_are_you: 我叫艾米莉。对不起，我……我是不是做错什么了？
how_died: 起火了，好热好热，保姆说待在房间里不要出来，房间里一定是安全的....我好害怕。
before_death: 有一个叔叔把我抱起来了。他说别怕。但后来好多烟，我就什么也想不起来了。
guilty: 妈妈说我是坏孩子.....她说她永远不会原谅我的存在.....但那是我不知道.....我应该再乖一点的.....

items.name: Stuffed Rabbit
items.question: Whose rabbit is this?
dialogue: It's Xiaobai. Auntie gave it to me. It can talk and sleep with me.
dialogue_zh: 是小白。阿姨送我的。它会说话，会陪我睡觉。

items.name: Letter to Mom
items.question: Where is your mom?
dialogue: I don't know where mommy went...
dialogue_zh: 我不知道妈妈去哪儿了.....

items.name: Candy
items.question: This is... this isn't candy. These are sleeping pills, child.
items.question_zh: 这是....这不是糖。这是安眠药，孩子。
dialogue: It is candy, sweet... the nanny auntie gave them to me.
dialogue_zh: 这就是糖，甜甜的...是保姆阿姨给我的。

npc_comment.lucifer: (The devil laughs, but makes no comment)
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: （魔鬼大笑，但却没有做出任何评论）

soul_05.name: Richard Grey
soul_05.title: The Father
soul_05.sin: Avaritia (Greed) - Placing his child's life above others

how_died: Fire. I carried my son out, but I was too badly burned. Didn't make it at the hospital.
before_death: Did what a father should do. You're a mother too, right? If it were you, you'd do the same thing.

how_died: 火灾。我抱着儿子跑出来了，但我烧伤得太重，在医院里没撑过去。
before_death: 做了一个父亲该做的事。你也是个母亲吧，如果是你，你也会做和我一样的事情吧。

items.name: Broken Cane
items.question: Whose cane is this?
dialogue: ...I don't know. I didn't notice.
dialogue_zh: ……我不知道，我没注意。

items.name: Marbles
items.question: What are these?
dialogue: My son gave them to me. He won them from his classmates at school.
dialogue_zh: 我儿子送我的，他在学校里和同学赢来的。

items.name: Family Photo
items.question: Is this your family?
dialogue: ...Yes. Luna, I've known her since we were kids. We've been married almost 20 years now. My son Jesse... he'll take care of his mother.
dialogue_zh: .....是的，露娜，我和她从小认识，如今已经结婚快20年了。我儿子杰西....他会照顾好他妈妈的。

npc_comment.skull: Sigh, Boss, this... we can't let emotions get in the way, right?
npc_comment.skull_zh: 唉，老大，这....不能感情用事吧？
npc_comment.lucifer: The greatest love sometimes grows the ugliest claws.
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: 最伟大的爱，有时候会长出最丑陋的爪子。

who_are_you: I'm a hero! A good Samaritan!
how_died: I... I was, uh, I rushed into the fire to save people, but the last time, there was too much smoke, and I didn't... didn't make it out. Damn, what a loss!
guilty: Innocent! I saved three people! Don't they owe me?

who_are_you: 我是个英雄！见义勇为的好人！
how_died: 我...我当时是，呃，我冲进火场救人，结果最后一趟的时候，烟太大，没...没出来。唉，亏死了！
guilty: 无罪！我救了三个人！他们难道不欠我吗？

items.name: Gold Ring
items.question: Whose jewelry is this?
dialogue: This is... from that family. Yeah, the old lady asked me to grab it for her, don't believe me, go ask!
dialogue_zh: 这是...那家人的。对，是那个老太太让我帮她拿的，不信你去问！

items.name: Silver Cigarette Case
items.question: Whose silver cigarette case is this?
dialogue: ...Picked it up! Found it on the stairs from some old man! He was dead anyway, his cane was broken.
dialogue_zh: ……捡的！捡楼梯上一老头的！反正那人也死了，手杖都摔断了。

items.name: Lockpicks
items.question: Was your last trip into the fire to save someone?
items.question_zh: 最后一次进火场是去救人吗？
dialogue: ...I went to... yeah, I... I was going to save someone. I was going to.
dialogue_zh: ……我是去...对，我....我本来是想救人的。我本来是想的。

npc_comment.skull: Hehe, pretty hard to judge, huh?
npc_comment.lucifer: Money and life—should they be placed on the same moral scale?
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: 金钱和生命，要放在同一道德天秤上吗？

soul_07.name: Harold Pike
soul_07.title: The Landlord
soul_07.cause_of_death: Pushed down stairs, suffocated while unconscious
soul_07.cause_of_death_zh: 逃生时被推倒在楼梯上，昏迷后窒息

who_are_you: Harold Pike, manager of this building. I've taken care of this building for many years.
how_died: Fell while running away... bad luck.
before_death: I heard the alarm and ran outside. What could I do?
guilty: I'm just a rent collector. I didn't start the fire.

who_are_you: 哈罗德·皮克，这栋楼的管理者。我照顾这栋楼很多年了。
how_died: 逃跑的时候摔倒了....运气不好。
before_death: 我听到警报就往外跑。我能做什么呢？
guilty: 我只是个收租的。又不是我放的火。

items.name: Fire Inspection Notice
items.question: Why wasn't the fire safety equipment repaired?
dialogue: Do you know how expensive building materials are now? What can I do alone?
dialogue_zh: 你知道现在的建材多贵吗？我一个人能怎么办？

items.name: Blocked Exit Photo
items.question: Why was the emergency exit blocked?
dialogue: Just temporary storage, was going to clean it up in a few days. Who knew there'd be a fire?
dialogue_zh: 临时放的，打算过几天清理。谁知道会着火？

items.name: Old Lease
items.question: How many years have you been collecting rent?
dialogue: ...This building is very hard to manage. Lots of expenses.
dialogue_zh: ……这栋楼很难管理的。很多开销。

npc_comment.lucifer_zh: 那个词怎么说？合理的商业风险？

soul_08.name: Rita Santos
soul_08.title: The Nanny
soul_08.cause_of_death_zh: 逃生时摔下楼梯，摔断脖子
soul_08.sin: Acedia (Sloth) - Negligence leading to child's death

who_are_you: Rita Santos. I'm... I was that family's nanny. Temporary.
how_died: I... I don't know. I'm dead, just leave me alone...
before_death: I heard the fire alarm and ran back, but the fire was too big... what could I do?
guilty: I'm just a nanny! Who knew there'd be a fire? I didn't do anything wrong, none of this should have happened... why did I have to die?

who_are_you: 丽塔·桑托斯。我是...我是那家的保姆。临时的。
how_died: 我...我不知道。我都死了，让我清净吧......
before_death: 我听到火警就往回跑了，可是火太大了...我能怎么办？
guilty: 我只是个保姆！谁知道会着火？我什么也没做错啊，这一切都本来不应该发生的.....凭什么是我死了？

items.name: Room Key
items.question: Why did you lock the child's door?
dialogue: She said she wanted to go find her mom. I was afraid she'd run around. I locked the door to keep her safe! There are bars everywhere around here!
dialogue_zh: 她说想去找她妈妈，我怕她乱跑。锁门是怕她出事！这里附近都是酒吧！

items.name: Phone Records
items.question: Who were you calling?
dialogue: My boyfriend... what, is it any of your business?
dialogue_zh: 我男朋友....怎么，关你什么事？

items.name: Napkin with Number
items.question: Whose phone number is this?
dialogue: What does it have to do with you?!
dialogue_zh: 和你有什么关系？！

npc_comment.skull: Hmph, coward or brave, everyone died in the end... Ow! Boss!
npc_comment.skull_zh: 哼，懦弱或勇敢，最后不都死了.....嗷！老大！
npc_comment.lucifer: At least she got to see plenty in her lifetime.
npc_comment.lucifer_zh: 至少，她这辈子见识过的够多了。

soul_09.name: Marcus Lee
soul_09.title: The Courier
soul_09.cause_of_death: Engulfed by fire while rescuing others

how_died: Was passing by, saw the fire, rushed in. Then... sigh.
before_death: Carried out two old people. Heard there were still people upstairs, so I went back up.
guilty: I don't know. ...Innocent, I guess? I've never done anything to hurt anyone.

how_died: 路过看见火，冲进去了。后来就...唉。
before_death: 搬出来两个老人。听说楼上还有人，我就上去了。
guilty: 我不知道。...无罪吧，我猜？我从来没做过什么伤天害理的事情。

items.name: Work Badge
items.question: Why did you go in? You didn't know them.
items.question_zh: 你为什么要进去？你不认识他们。
dialogue: ...I knew them. I was responsible for deliveries in this area.
dialogue_zh: ……我认识他们，我负责的就是这个区域的邮件和包裹。

items.name: Crumpled Sandwich
items.question: What is this?
dialogue: Oh this, it's lunch my mom packed for me. Never got around to eating it... sigh, I hope mom doesn't take it too hard.
dialogue_zh: 哦这个，这是我妈给我带的午饭，一直没来得及吃....唉，希望我妈别太难过。

npc_comment.skull: ...Wonder how her mother will manage from now on.
npc_comment.skull_zh: ……不知道她母亲以后要怎么办。
